description: Check a player's 40 most-played Steam games against Valve's Steam Machine and Steam Deck ratings (Verified, Playable, Unsupported), with shares weighted by playtime. Ratings: 3 Verified, 2 Playable, 1 Unsupported, 0 not tested. Use for 'should I buy a Steam Machine / Steam Deck'.
